The issue is caused by `redbot/core/utils/views.py::SimpleMenu.on_timeout` attempting to perform Discord API actions (either `delete()` or `edit()`) on a message that may no longer exist.

When a `SimpleMenu` times out, it tries to clean up the interaction by either deleting the message or removing the view. However, if the message has already been deleted (e.g., by a user or another process), the Discord API returns a `404 Not Found (Unknown Message)` error. Because `on_timeout` is an asynchronous task triggered by the view's timeout, this unhandled exception results in the `Task exception was never retrieved` error seen in the traceback. Additionally, the traceback shows a secondary error where a callback tries to `defer()` an interaction that is already expired/unknown, which is a side effect of the timing of the timeout.

To resolve this, `redbot/core/utils/views.py::SimpleMenu.on_timeout` must be updated to gracefully handle `discord.NotFound` exceptions. Wrapping the cleanup logic in a `try/except discord.NotFound` block will prevent these errors from bubbling up as unhandled task exceptions when the message is already gone.
